command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

BV=$(bcftools --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $2}')
TS=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_start"{print $2}' truth.tsv)
TE=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_end"{print $2}'   truth.tsv)
TL=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_len"{print $2}'   truth.tsv)
read -r DS DE DL < depth_interval.txt

echo "== read delly's call (its own image ships no bcftools) =="
bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t%FILTER\t%INFO/SVTYPE\t%INFO/END\t%INFO/SVLEN\t%INFO/PRECISE\t%INFO/PE\t%INFO/SR\t[%GT]\n' sv.bcf > sv.tsv
cat sv.tsv
NREC=$(awk 'END{print NR+0}' sv.tsv)
test "$NREC" = "1" || { echo "expected exactly 1 SV call across 20 kb, got $NREC"; exit 1; }
read -r CH POS FIL TYPE END SVLEN PREC PE SR GT < sv.tsv

# delly's VCF convention: POS is the base BEFORE the deletion, END the base AFTER it.
# So the DELETED interval is POS+1 .. END-1 -- and that is what must match the truth.
CALLS=$(( POS + 1 ))
CALLE=$(( END - 1 ))
test "$TYPE" = "DEL"  || { echo "SVTYPE is $TYPE, not DEL"; exit 1; }
test "$FIL"  = "PASS" || { echo "call did not PASS: $FIL"; exit 1; }
test "$PREC" = "1"    || { echo "call is IMPRECISE -- an exact breakpoint claim is not licensed"; exit 1; }
test "$CALLS" = "$TS" || { echo "called start $CALLS != planted $TS"; exit 1; }
test "$CALLE" = "$TE" || { echo "called end $CALLE != planted $TE"; exit 1; }

# The proxy that LOOKS right and is not: |SVLEN| is END-POS, one more than the deleted length.
ABSLEN=${SVLEN#-}
NAIVE=no; [ "$ABSLEN" = "$TL" ] && NAIVE=yes
test "$ABSLEN" = "$(( TL + 1 ))" || { echo "SVLEN convention changed: |SVLEN|=$ABSLEN, expected $(( TL + 1 ))"; exit 1; }

# Two independent signals, cross-checked the only way they can be: containment.
CONT=no; [ "$DS" -ge "$CALLS" ] && [ "$DE" -le "$CALLE" ] && CONT=yes
test "$CONT" = yes || { echo "coverage gap $DS-$DE is not inside delly's call $CALLS-$CALLE"; exit 1; }

{
printf 'Structural variants -- a planted deletion found by two independent signals\n'
printf 'bcftools_version\t%s\n' "$BV"
printf 'sv_calls\t%s   (assert 1 -- EXACT: one call in 20 kb, no false positives)\n' "$NREC"
printf 'svtype_filter_precise\t%s / %s / PRECISE   (assert DEL / PASS / PRECISE)\n' "$TYPE" "$FIL"
printf 'evidence\tPE=%s split-reads=%s  GT=%s\n' "$PE" "$SR" "$GT"
printf 'delly_breakpoints\t%s-%s   (POS+1 .. END-1, from POS=%s END=%s)\n' "$CALLS" "$CALLE" "$POS" "$END"
printf 'planted_deletion\t%s-%s (%s bp)\n' "$TS" "$TE" "$TL"
printf 'breakpoints_exact\tyes   (assert yes -- EXACT to the base, licensed by PRECISE)\n'
printf 'svlen_reported\t%s   (assert |SVLEN| = %s = del_len+1 -- delly reports END-POS, NOT the deleted length)\n' "$SVLEN" "$(( TL + 1 ))"
printf 'naive_svlen_check\t%s   (a reader asserting |SVLEN|==%s FAILS on this correct call -- that is the point)\n' "$NAIVE" "$TL"
printf 'coverage_gap\t%s-%s (%s bp)\n' "$DS" "$DE" "$DL"
printf 'signals_agree\t%s   (assert yes -- coverage gap CONTAINED in delly call; equality is not available,\n' "$CONT"
printf 'signals_agree\t     because split reads resolve the breakpoint to the base and coverage cannot)\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
